title: Yoisaki Kanade — In The Dark〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I think we all know where we'll be looking tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, here...
It's this sewing lounge.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You'd probably pass through Main Street to get there from the station, so I should keep an eye out for Mizuki on my way over...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've finished doing my homework, so I'm free to work now. What are your plans...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I just found where I'll be going tomorrow, so I think I'll start working too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I was wondering what Mizuki is doing right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Between having to deal with supplementary classes and such, nothing seemed all that strange when we got that message saying, “I won't be able to work for a while”...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was under the same impression initially.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Ena's also been acting a little strange lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. In hindsight, there were a lot of clues that I could've picked up on.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It would've been nice to see this as a music video, but Amia seems very busy. We'll just have to go with a still frame this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, it's strange to not see or hear from Amia for so long. We talk almost every day, so things feel a little emptier than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It sounded like you were trying to say something just now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena's probably been trying to figure out what to do since that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, when did you notice that Ena was acting a little strange...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When the three of us were working on that song we uploaded the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Despite not being muted, she was eerily quiet. And she never gave us any concrete responses to our questions...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At first, I thought she hadn't been getting enough sleep.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, since that's happened a few times before.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Ena doesn't usually hide what she's feeling in those situations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, when she was working on the illustration for our last song, she was quiet for most of the time. Especially after Mizuki stopped joining us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I didn't think it had anything to do with Ena not getting enough sleep or anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought something else probably happened.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ena didn't tell us what happened between her and Mizuki, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Based on the expression we saw on Ena's face, it must be very serious.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We need to find Mizuki, tell Ena and give them a chance to talk.
